s.how: Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion and roll in 2 sheets puff pastry. Cut into small pieces, brush with milk and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

s.note: the snowy streets of Victorian London
s.how: Cut a cross in the flat side of 500g chestnuts. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until the skins curl back, wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes and peel while warm.

m.note: the prize turkey Scrooge sends to the Cratchits
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg turkey breast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Bake stuffing of 150g breadcrumbs, diced onion, chopped sage and melted butter. Serve with apple sauce and gravy.

w.how: Heat an 800g Christmas pudding and turn it onto a plate. Warm 60ml brandy, pour over, light carefully and let the flames die. Serve with warm custard.

d.note: Scrooge promising Bob a bowl of smoking bishop
d.how: Stud 2 oranges with 6 cloves and roast for 20 minutes. Slice into a pan with 750ml port and 3 tbsp sugar and heat for 15 minutes without boiling. Heat apple juice with spices for the kids.
